div.l: For in his purs . he schulde punyschid be .
Purs . is the Erchedekens helle . seide he .
But well I wote . he lied right in dede .
Of cursyng . oughte eche gilty man to drede .
For curs woll sleen . right as assoylyng saueth .
And also war hym . of a signyficauyth .
In daunger had he . at his owne gyse .
The yong gerles . of the diocyse .
And knewe here counseile . ⁊and what was all here rede .
A garland had he . set vp on his hede .
As gret as it were . for an ale stake .
A bokeler had he . made hym of a cake .
With hym ther rode . a gentill pardoner .
Of Rounciuall . his frende ⁊and his comper .
That streight was come . fro the court of Rome .
Full lowe he songe . come hider loue to me .
This sompnorur bar to hym . a stif burdoıı̄un .
Was neủer trompe . of half so gret a soıı̄un .
This ꝑperdoner had heer . as yelwe as wax .
But smothe it henge . as doth a strike of flax .
By ounces henge his lokkes . that he hadde .
And ther with he . his schuldris ouerspradde .
But thynne it laye . bi culpūns oon bi oon
But hood for iolyte . werid he non .
For it was trussed vp . in his walet .
Hym thought he rode . all on the newe iet .
Discheuele saaf his cappe . he rode all bare .
Suche glaryng eyen . had he as an hare .
A vernycle had he . sewed vp on his cappe .
His walet laye bifore hym . in his lappe .
Bretfull of ꝑperdoıı̄un . comen fro Rome all hoot .
A voys he had . as small as a goot .
No berde ne had he . ne neuyr / schulde haue .
As smothe it was . as it were late schaue .
I trowe he were . a geldyng or a mare .
But of his crafte . fro Berwik in to ware .
Ne was ther / such a nother pardoner .
For in his male . he had a pelewber
Whiche that he seide . was our / lady veile .
He seide he had . a gobet of the seile .
That seynt Petir hadde . whan that he wente .
Vp on the see . till Ihu Criste hym hente .
He had a croos of latoıı̄un . full of stones .
And in a glas . he had piggis bones .
But with these relikis . whan that he fonde .
A poủere ꝑpersone . dwellyng vp on londe .
Vp on a day . he gat hym more moneye . /
